title: P2RLN H5P Profile
description: Binds a P2RLN activity to an H5P package while preserving H5P content and distinguishing packages with bundled libraries from packages that depend on libraries supplied by the host.
rules: An original .h5p package SHOULD be preserved byte-for-byte when available.
P2RLN MUST NOT reinterpret h5p.json, content.json, library.json or semantics.json as Core structures.
A representation SHOULD record mainLibrary, embedTypes, declared dependencies and dependencyMode (bundled, external or mixed).
A processor MAY preserve an H5P representation without having all declared H5P libraries installed.
Delivery requires an H5P-capable runtime and all required libraries; preservation alone does not imply delivery capability.
Delivery MUST occur inside the H5P runtime/security boundary rather than by treating the package as passive Core content.
